meta.name: pr-lens
meta.description: WHAT: Draws a code change or part of a codebase as an animated architecture or data-flow diagram, on its own or in a pull request. WHEN: asked to diagram, visualise or explain a change or a system, or when a pull request should carry a diagram. KEYWORDS: PR Lens, diagram, architecture, data flow, visualise, visualize, pull request

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 画出动画架构图或数据流图,让代码改动和系统结构一眼看懂
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果代码改动总是说不清,评审时想让大家一眼看懂
copy.tagline_en: Turn a code change or system into an animated diagram
copy.fit_line_en: For you if reviewers struggle to follow what your code changes do

howto.what: 它会读代码改动或代码库的一部分,写出一份描述图表的 JSON,再渲染成带动画的 SVG 架构图或数据流图。结果可以推到一个网页画布并给你链接,或作为图片附到 PR 描述、评论里。
howto.when: 当你要求把某个改动或系统画成图、可视化或解释,提到 PR Lens、architecture、data flow 等关键词,或需要给 PR 配图时触发。

say.text: 把这次改动画成架构图,给我链接
say.note: 渲染 SVG 并推到画布,返回查看链接

say.text: 给这个 PR 的描述加一张架构图
say.note: 用 gh --attach 把图上传进 PR 描述

say.text: 数据流里加上队列这一步,重新渲染
say.note: 改文档、校验、渲染后推同一个链接

howto.what_en: It reads a diff or part of a codebase, writes a JSON document describing the diagrams, and renders animated SVG architecture or data-flow diagrams. Output can go to a canvas link or be attached to a pull request body or comment.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to diagram, visualise or explain a change or a system, mention PR Lens, architecture or data flow, or when a pull request should carry a diagram.

say_en.text: Draw this change as an architecture diagram and give me the link
say_en.note: Renders SVGs, pushes a canvas, returns a view link

say_en.text: Add an architecture diagram to this PR description
Add the queue step to the flow and re-render
say_en.note: Edits, validates, renders, re-pushes the same link
